authority_contract.handoff_resolver_boundary: The injected fixture resolver represents a trusted resolver that has already validated the complete same-actor authoritative handoff envelope; the core never accepts a caller-provided bare success boolean as proof.

trusted_execution_boundary.node_path_policy: NODE_PATH is rejected before execution and cleared inside the inherited runner; no module is loaded through NODE_PATH.
trusted_execution_boundary.node_and_fengari_policy: The inherited runner verifies a signed Node executable, removes injection variables, pins its cached Fengari closure, verifies the Lua test source hash, and runs the package Y3 API-isolation gate.
trusted_execution_boundary.trusted_filesystem_precondition: For one invocation, the package, inherited runner, selected Node executable, and pinned Fengari closure are controlled by the trusted executor.

acceptance: Authority-only Lv41 and DF_E_YANLUO_HALL handoff entry is accepted; direct protected Difu progression use is absent.
Three logical records have ordered writers, current-lifecycle prerequisites, and actor-event replay returns the existing result only when every bound receipt field is unchanged.
Lingxiao admission freezes one to four authority members and rejects proxy, forged, unentered, and stale members.
Only active, effective frozen members receive mainline completion; cleanup failure cannot erase it.
Cleanup requires matching instance, epoch, revision, and token before locks release.
